video_title: Derrick White Talks Jaylen Brown, the New-Look Celtics, the 2026 Season & More!

quotes.speaker: Derrick White
quotes.summary_phrase: Derrick White reflects on his decade in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I remember my rookie year, Chip England came up to me and was like, the goal is to get to 10.
quotes.quote: It is pretty insane. I remember my rookie year, Chip England came up to me and was like, the goal is to get to 10. If you get to 10 years, your kids will be good, your kids' kids will be good, the health insurance, the pension. That has always been a goal of mine, to get to year 10, and for it to be here, it seems crazy because it feels like my rookie year was two years ago. I have been in the league for a while too, so it is a weird gray area, but I am super blessed to be able to play in the NBA for 10 years. It is something that I never thought I would be able to do and be a part of, and it has been a lot of fun, a lot of winning, a lot of great organizations I have been a part of, and I love it.

quotes.speaker: Derrick White
quotes.summary_phrase: Derrick White praises Mitchell Robinson's rebounding ability
quotes.excerpt: He has incredible hands for a big man. He gets a fingertip in, and he's pulling it in.
quotes.quote: I was also crazy impressed with Paul George's hands on the defensive end. I was also crazy impressed, obviously we have watched Mitchell Robinson play, and offensive rebound the way he does. But when I was sitting there trying to crack the code, I am like, how is he getting all these rebounds? He has incredible hands for a big man. He gets a fingertip in, and he's pulling it in. He is some of the best I have ever seen. He gets a fingertip in and he's pulling it in.

quotes.speaker: Derrick White
quotes.summary_phrase: Derrick White on the impact of Mitchell Robinson's play
quotes.excerpt: It has been great having Mitchell Robinson. Big-time player. You learn different things about people when you're playing with them.
quotes.quote: It has been great having Mitchell Robinson. Big-time player. You learn different things about people when you're playing with them and get to know them. Just hanging out with him has been great getting to know him, and he does a lot of great things on the court offensively, defensively, and he's just getting more and more comfortable with how we run our scheme and everything, and it's going to be a fun year.

quotes.speaker: Derrick White
quotes.summary_phrase: Derrick White on the difficulty of losing Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: The tough part about this business is you build these relationships, you become teammates, you reach the highs.
quotes.quote: The tough part about this business is you build these relationships, you become teammates, you reach the highs, you experience the lows together, and then one day they're not your teammate anymore. I'm always thankful for the welcoming Jaylen Brown gave me when I came to Boston, and he's always given me confidence, always trusted in me, which I'm truly thankful for, especially for someone that's one of the best players in the NBA. It's been amazing to see his work ethic, it's been amazing to see the things he's done in the community, the numerous things and impacts that he's made around the Boston area that definitely inspired me and motivated me to do more.
